summary: Hyliion Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a $42 million cost-plus-fixed-fee contract with the Office of Naval Research for the HELMUR Megawatt Scale Power Generation Units program. The contract involves designing, building, and delivering 2- and 3-megawatt generators over 36 months, with work in Cedar Park, TX, expected to complete by July 2029. Funding is from FY2025/2026 Navy appropriations. This is a routine government contract award, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or shareholder implications beyond the company's ordinary business.
